title: Generalized fractional Laguerre orthogonal functions: projection and interpolation estimates
summary: Classical Laguerre spectral approximations are highly effective on the half-line when the target function is smooth in the usual polynomial scale. However, their accuracy deteriorates for nonsmooth functions. Such behavior appears naturally in fractional models, weakly singular integral equations, and semi-infinite-domain approximations with limited regularity near the origin. The main contribution of this work is the construction and analysis of a fractional Laguerre approximation framework tailored to nonsmooth functions on the half-line.
